# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
  `tests.yml` job `test`: `services` is not supported and was dropped; Docker services and containers come in a later release
validate: exit 0

  tests: triggered
    job test (3.12) on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      matrix python-version="3.12"
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step actions/setup-python@v5
      step run: python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      step run: pytest --junitxml=reports/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
      step Keep the test report if always(): ok=run/run fail=run/run
